## Decision needed

Decision/question ID from docs/DECISIONS.md and the user outcome it affects.

## Options and evidence

Describe alternatives, primary sources where relevant, uncertainty, and operational costs. Keep private reference identities and source out of the issue.

## Recommendation and consequences

Affected workflow steps, compatibility/privacy/authorization implications, and a concrete validation approach.
